title: Correct time of flight
description: Essential: The response must correctly calculate the time to fall using t = sqrt(2h/g).

title: Minimum horizontal distance
description: Essential: The response must identify the minimum horizontal distance to land in the pot as L.

title: Maximum horizontal distance
description: Essential: The response must identify the maximum horizontal distance to land in the pot as 3L.

title: Speed from horizontal motion
description: Important: The response must correctly relate initial speed to horizontal distance via v0 = x / t.

title: Final inequality form
description: Important: The final answer must be presented as a range inequality (e.g., v0_min < v0 < v0_max).

title: Algebraic simplification
description: Optional: The response shows the simplified expressions v0_min = L*sqrt(g/(2h)) and v0_max = 3L*sqrt(g/(2h)).

title: Incorrect geometric range
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the maximum horizontal distance is incorrectly taken as L or 2L instead of 3L.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the answer includes incorrect units or sign errors in the kinematic equations.
